patch_description: This evolution introduces a learned base for each RY group (corner, edge, center) plus per-upload deltas for the three uploads. The base captures shared rotation motifs across the Tic-Tac-Toe symmetry groups, while the per-upload deltas inject expressivity without increasing depth. This adheres to the EVOLVE-BLOCK constraints, preserves data encoding, re-uploading layout, and training loop, and only edits ANSATZ_SPEC along with the internal apply_ansatz_block logic to assemble final angles. The result is a larger, but more flexible parameter space that aims to reduce validation/test gaps and improve overall performance.
